C24 shares discussion of Federal-State assistance and financially constrained States, but only at a broad policy level and without distinctive shared language or parallel machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The most compelling reason for disapproval of this bill is my firm belief that the unsound principle on which it is based would seriously hinder further progress","parent_excerpt":"I do not wish my action in approving S. 1990 to be construed as endorsing the principle of extending generally the basic 40-year repayment period","explanation":"C08 similarly distinguishes a particular bill from acceptance of a broader principle, but this is a general policy-evaluation move rather than concrete shared drafting."},{"child_excerpt":"A bill such as H.R. 6818 ... offers no real solution to the problems of the needy blind.","parent_excerpt":"As a general rule I question the soundness of distributing Indian capital funds in per capita payments.","explanation":"C20 also assesses legislation against a general policy rule, but it approves an exceptional measure and uses a materially different rationale and structure."},{"child_excerpt":"special provisions relating Federal grants more equitably to the financial resources and needs of the various States","parent_excerpt":"The cost of providing adequate systems of schools has long been beyond the financial resources of many of our States.","explanation":"C24 shares concern about unequal State fiscal capacity in a Federal-State program, but that overlap is topical and not evidence of a reusable textual or structural template."}]}
